items.prompt:
Vertical angles are always:
A) Supplementary
B) Equal
C) Right angles
D) Zero

steps: Opposite angles at an intersection are equal.

items.prompt:
If one vertical angle is $55°$, the other is:
A) $35°$
B) $55°$
C) $125°$
D) $180°$

Alternate interior angles between parallel lines are:
A) Supplementary
B) Equal
C) Complementary
D) Right

Same-side interior angles between parallel lines sum to:
A) $90°$
B) $180°$
C) $360°$
D) $45°$

A transversal angle is $100°$. Its corresponding angle (parallel lines) is:
A) $80°$
B) $100°$
C) $180°$
D) $50°$

A point equidistant from a segment's two endpoints lies on the:
A) Angle bisector
B) Perpendicular bisector
C) Median
D) Transversal

steps: Equidistant means on the perpendicular bisector.

items.prompt:
Same-side interior angles are $2x$ and $x$. Find $x$.
A) $30°$
B) $45°$
C) $60°$
D) $90°$

An angle in a linear pair is $125°$. The vertical angle to its partner is:
A) $55°$
B) $125°$
C) $35°$
D) $90°$

steps: Partner is $55°$; its vertical angle equals $55°$.
